li.label: the fields blessed
li.description: We walked the rows together before the planting and said the words. Whatever comes up this year, we started it right.

li.label: remembered our dead
li.description: We walked to the graves together and said their names out loud. It was sad, and it was good to do.

li.label: the midsummer swim
li.description: A whole afternoon in the water with everyone, on the hottest day of the year. I'm still a little sunburnt.

li.label: the harvest dance
li.description: We danced until the fire burned down. My feet hurt and I don't care.

li.label: first-frost soup
li.description: Hot soup from the big pot on the first cold day, all of us standing round it with our breath steaming.

li.label: lantern night
li.description: Every window lit at once in the dark of winter. We looked like somewhere worth coming home to.
